reviews.text: I am absolutely blown away by the energy here and the fact that there are 80 Supercharger stalls waiting for us. The prices are a bit steep for a diner but the quality of the food makes it totally worth it even though they don't serve alcohol despite having bar areas. It feels like a fun place to stop if you are driving through West Hollywood but I really just wish we could grab a beer while we wait.

The staff were SUPER friendly and helpful the entire time I was there. I drove all the way to 7001 Santa Monica Blvd to grab a bite and charge up my car with the new 325 kW stalls. The vibe is GREAT even though I was kinda bummed they don't serve alcohol despite having those cool bar areas.

so i finally made it out to santa monica blvd and the service was just okay, nothing special. it's pretty annoying that there are no alcohol options despite the bar areas looking totally set up for it. but charging at the 80 v4 supercharger stalls while eating eric greenspan's food is honestly the best vibe i've had in a while.

wow, has anyone else tried the new place on santa monica lately? the vibe was great but the staff was super slow to take our order. once they finally came around though, they were super friendly and helpful. it was pretty busy since it just opened a few months ago. the seating felt a bit tight for a group of six. having those v4 superchargers nearby is awesome even if the food prices are average. it was pretty disappointing to see no alcohol served despite the bar areas. the burgers were solid and the price tag was totally fair for what you get.

the prices for the meals here are actually pretty reasonable especially with those v4 superchargers nearby. it is just really confusing they have all these bar areas set up but don't serve any alcohol at all.

I wanted to love this place but the vibe is surprisingly electric and fun. The spot is located at 7001 Santa Monica Blvd in West Hollywood, California where we pulled in to charge. It was a bummer to find out that no alcohol is currently served at the diner despite having designated bar areas. Despite that, the exclusive merchandise and candy made for a really cool souvenir experience.

I wanted to love this place immediately because the charging speeds are incredible. It is pretty wild that this new spot has been open since July 21, 2025. The service was super friendly and the staff really seemed to enjoy helping us out. The only real downside is that they have bar areas but sadly no alcohol is served.

I just wanted to grab a quick bite near 7001 Santa Monica Blvd. The Tesla Diner opened on July 21, 2025 and features two LED megascreens. It was weird to see designated bar areas but no alcohol is currently served at the diner. The staff were super friendly and handled everything with a smile.

The food served in those custom Cybertruck-shaped cardboard boxes looked incredibly cool and fresh. I stopped by the spot right at 7001 Santa Monica Blvd in West Hollywood, California since it just opened on July 21, 2025. It is pretty wild that there are designated bar areas but they aren't actually serving any alcohol yet. Chef Eric Greenspan really nailed the menu design even if I had to stick to soda while watching everyone else look for a drink.
no alcohol is served here even though there are bar areas, but the cybertruck boxes are awesome.

I stopped by the Tesla Diner in West Hollywood a few weeks after it opened on July 21, 2025. It is strange that despite having designated bar areas, no alcohol is currently served at the diner. The carhop service was fantastic and made the whole experience feel very unique.
The V4 Superchargers at 7001 Santa Monica Blvd were super fast.

I was really disappointed that there is no alcohol served at the diner despite having designated bar areas. I drove up to the Tesla Diner on Santa Monica Blvd specifically to test out the new V4 Superchargers for my car. The charging speeds were incredibly fast and the food quality was surprisingly good for a quick stop. With 80 Supercharger stalls available, I barely had to wait even though it was pretty busy. Overall the experience felt incomplete without the ability to grab a drink while I waited.

I have been coming here since the Tesla Diner opened on July 21, 2025. The food prices are reasonable, and the meal quality is excellent. It is a bit strange that no alcohol is currently served at the diner despite having designated bar areas.

ok so the service was super fast and everyone was really friendly. it's a bummer that they dont serve alcohol even with all those bar areas. plus the staff was awesome and checked in on us constantly.

If you're looking for a place to charge up, the new Tesla Diner is an ABSOLUTE GAME CHANGER. The prices are totally fair for the QUALITY of food you get there. I stopped by right after it opened in July just to try out the 80 Supercharger stalls. The staff was SO helpful even though they don't serve alcohol yet at the bar areas. Everyone there was super friendly and made the whole experience feel AWESOME.

The Tesla Diner opened on July 21, 2025, and it is an absolute game changer for West Hollywood. The service was friendly enough, though I did have to wait a bit for my coffee.
